en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large multi-story brick high school building with a central tower and arched entrance, set along a broad street lined with palm trees and a telephone pole. A smaller house stands to the left, and there are handwritten numbers in red and black ink near the top and left sides. Printed red text at the lower right reads "High School, San Bernardino, Cal."
